test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the options given below.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Comparision**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Comparision"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Comparison"**.
 
• **"Comparison"** refers to the act of comparing two or more things to evaluate their similarities and differences. (तुलना)
 
 
• **Example: **In **comparison **to last year, this year's sales have increased significantly.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noticeable **(ध्यान देने योग्य): Easily seen or noticed.

 
 
• **Example:** The changes in the policy were **noticeable **to all employees.
 
 
 
• **Amateur **(शौकिया): A person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an **amateur **photographer who loves capturing nature.
 
 
 
• **Deficiency** (कमी): A lack or shortage of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor diagnosed him with a vitamin **deficiency**.
